description: This file is a type-annotated Python interface (.pyi) for the PyTorch RPC distributed communication module, defining classes, functions, and variables related to remote procedure calls in distributed training environments.

classes.name: RpcBackendOptions
classes.description: Base class for RPC backend configuration options, including timeout and init method.

classes.name: WorkerInfo
classes.description: Represents information about a worker in the distributed environment, including name and ID.

classes.name: RpcAgent
classes.description: Abstract class defining the interface for an RPC agent managing communication between workers.

classes.name: PyRRef
classes.description: Represents a Python Remote Reference, encapsulating remote objects and providing methods for remote and local access.

classes.name: _TensorPipeRpcBackendOptionsBase
classes.description: Configuration options specific to the TensorPipe RPC backend, including device maps and worker threads.

classes.name: TensorPipeAgent
classes.description: Implementation of RpcAgent for the TensorPipe RPC backend, managing worker info, device mappings, and group membership.

classes.name: RemoteProfilerManager
classes.description: Provides functionality to set the current profiling key for remote profiling sessions.

methods.name: RpcBackendOptions.__init__
methods.description: Constructor for initializing RPC backend options like timeout and init method.

methods.name: WorkerInfo.__init__
methods.description: Constructs WorkerInfo with a name and worker ID.

methods.name: WorkerInfo.name
methods.description: Property to get the worker's name.

methods.name: WorkerInfo.id
methods.description: Property to get the worker's ID.

methods.name: RpcAgent.join
methods.description: Join the RPC worker thread, optionally shutting down.

methods.name: PyRRef.rpc_sync
methods.description: Synchronously retrieve the value from a remote reference.

methods.name: _get_device_map
methods.description: Get the device mapping for communication with a specific worker.

methods.name: TensorPipeAgent._update_group_membership
methods.description: Update the membership group for a TensorPipe RPC backend, managing device mappings.
